Author: Shintaxo
Name: Keybind Profiles
Description:
Character-specific keyboard profiles with preview and undo.
Changes primary bindings only, never actions. No automatic job switching.
Open with /keybindprofiles. Experimental plugin developed with AI assistance.
SESSION-ONLY HOTFIX: explicit game-file saving is disabled. After logout or restart you may need to manually reapply your profile. If an old backup is pending, use Undo profile switch before applying again; do not delete your saved profiles.
Punchline: Session-only keybind profiles; fixes the 0.1.4 undo-backup lock.
Changelog: 0.1.5 HOTFIX: disables unverified explicit game-file saving that blocked 0.1.4. Existing saves are preserved. If an old backup is pending, click Undo profile switch once, then preview/apply your desired profile. Restart persistence is not guaranteed.
